records.observation: Constructor copies supplied time bounds, caches duration once, creates category-keyed HashMap, zero real count, null category array/current bounds; nesting flag creates real list and start-time-ordered TreeSet blocks else bothnull. Inherited later bounds changes do not refresh cached duration. Copy constructor reconstructs bounds/nesting mode and merges source weights, not original real list. mergeWithReal uses intersection/boxDuration float inclusive ratio and intersection/drawableDuration*numPrimitives double count, new weight exclusive0 or adds existing; stores real drawable reference in nesting list. Shadow merge scales category ratios by intersection/boxDuration and counts by intersection/shadowDuration; total uses shadow real-object count; nests shadow reference into blocks. TimeAve merge similarly copies/scales new weights or accumulates existing, adds source box itself as timeblock when nesting. No overlap/zero-duration/finite/visibility/category-null checks, clamping, self-merge guard or array invalidation. patchSetOfTimeBlocks adds exterior ALL_TIMES-derived sentinels ending at box start or first overlapping block start and beginning at box end or last overlapping block end, based on contains; assumes usable non-null set. Exclusion iterates REAL LIST IN INSERTION ORDER without sorting, initializes each drawable exclusion against block array, pops stack until a covering ancestor, subtracts current exclusion from that nearest covering top then pushes current. Thus ordered-nesting precondition belongs to caller; original Drawable exclusion fields mutated. Clears/nulls set, then sums each real exclusion/boxDuration into category exclusive ratio and clears list. setNestingExclusion unconditionally invokes this sequence: false nesting flag fails, second call fails because set null; later nested shadow/box merges also dereference nullset while real list remains nonnull. getAveNum returns accumulated double, not a new mean. initializeCategoryTimeBoxes ONLY if arraynull, creates wrapper for EVERY map value in HashMap order, no visible/searchable filter, wrappers share weight references. array getter returns internal array directly including null before explicit init; sorting by summary renderers mutates shared order. Later new categories absent from cached array; existing weights remain shared/live. Confirms prior SummaryState observation: hidden entries are not excluded at this layer and may retain old/default display bounds while draw/pick iterate them, unless caller restricts inputs externally. Current timebox lazily created and returned mutable by reference. toString emits base bounds, count castfloat, separate weight array sorted inclusive; does not initialize/invalidate display array. Actual caller ordering, numerical use and runtime display remain separate obligations.
